title: Switching display changes the layout at once, keeping filters and search
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. On the Work Orders page with a filter tab selected, some search text typed, and a status filter applied.
custom_steps:
1. Note the current filter tab, search text, applied filters, and the visible work orders.
  2. Switch from List to Tech View.
  3. Switch to Board View.
  4. Compare the filter tab, search text, filters, and the set of work orders before and after each switch.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Switching the display re-lays out the same work orders instantly; the filter tab, search text, and filters do not change.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10044 — Story 1 Switch between display options. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S1-R3 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R3: “Switching display options immediately re-lays out the current results without changing the filter view, search text, or filters.”
